Engineering Consulting Services

At Viltis Consulting, our engineering consulting services are designed to support the intricate needs of the life sciences, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and biologics industries. Whether you're developing cutting-edge products or optimizing manufacturing processes, our team of skilled engineers provides the expertise necessary to ensure success at every stage. We specialize in process engineering,

: Designs and optimizes manufacturing processes to ensure efficiency and regulatory compliance.

: Manages and improves production systems, enhancing productivity and quality.

Technology Transfer Engineer

: Facilitates the seamless transfer of processes from development to full-scale production.

Engineering Project Manager

: Oversees engineering projects from concept to completion, ensuring they meet timelines and budgets.

: Manages the design, construction, and maintenance of pharmaceutical facilities to support safe and efficient operations.

: Conducts validation activities for processes, equipment, and systems to meet regulatory standards.

CSV/Data Integrity Engineer

: Ensures that computer systems are secure and comply with all regulatory requirements, safeguarding data integrity.

: Develops new medical devices and improves existing products, ensuring they meet user needs and regulatory standards.

: Designs mechanical components of medical devices, focusing on functionality and reliability.

Human Factors Engineer

: Ensures that medical devices are user-friendly and safe, minimizing risks and improving patient outcomes.

Manufacturing Engineer

: Optimizes manufacturing processes for medical devices, enhancing efficiency and product quality.

Process Development Engineer

: Develops and validates manufacturing processes, ensuring they are robust and scalable.

Engineering Project Manager

: Manages engineering projects within the medical device industry, ensuring timely and successful delivery.

: Oversees the design, construction, and maintenance of facilities used in medical device manufacturing, ensuring they meet regulatory and operational standards.

: Conducts validation for equipment, processes, and systems, ensuring they meet industry standards.

Software Validation Engineer

: Ensures that software used in medical devices complies with regulatory standards, maintaining safety and efficacy.

: Designs and optimizes processes for biologics production, ensuring efficiency and compliance.

Upstream/Downstream Process Engineer

: Manages specific stages of biologics production, focusing on process efficiency and product quality.

Manufacturing Engineer

: Ensures efficient and compliant production of biologic products, from raw materials to finished goods.

Technology Transfer Engineer

: Manages the transition from development to large-scale biologics production, ensuring seamless scale-up and adherence to regulatory requirements.

Engineering Project Manager:

Oversees projects related to biologics manufacturing and facility design, ensuring they are delivered on time and within budget.

: Manages biologics production facilities, ensuring they meet all compliance and operational efficiency standards.

: Ensures that all processes, equipment, and systems used in biologics production meet stringent regulatory standards.

Biologics Validation Specialist:

Focuses on the specific validation needs of biologic products, ensuring they meet all necessary regulatory requirements.
